_comment: Cyber theme palette — the single source of truth for color. Mirrors the `variables` block of 数字孪生.pen plus the inline accents the design uses directly. The skill derives BOTH SCSS variables and Three.js Color instances from this file — never duplicate hex literals across files. To retheme for a different park, edit the values here (and only here).

category._comment: Legend category → color mapping. Buildings are colored by category in the 3D scene and the on-screen Legend uses these swatches.

building._comment: v1.4 楼栋楼层/房间层次（§4）。roomShade = 每层 1–5 间房间相对类别色的明度偏移幅度（HSL lightness ±），用于在幕墙纹理上画出深浅不一的房间色块；dividerColor = 楼层之间贯穿横向虚线分隔的颜色（自发光青）。

shaders._comment: Default uniform values carried by the .pen's shader fills. Override per-park if needed.

environment._comment: v1.2 园区环境配色（道路/车位/绿化/围墙/路灯等，§10）。赛博气质：深蓝灰沥青 + 发光青色标线 + 暗紫青草地 + 霓虹树冠边光。所有颜色经此派生，不散落 hex。

garageEntrance._comment: v1.4 地下车库入口标记（§5）：半金字塔三角门框架 + P 牌。signBg/signFg 为高对比配对（深底亮字），取代旧的单色 sign——避免霓虹底+白字看不清。

surfaceParking._comment: v1.4 地面车位（§10）：长方形车位。stallFill=车位铺装底色、stallLine=车位描边、pMarkBg/pMark=每位印的 P 字底/字（高对比）、car=示意停放车辆车身色。旧 frame/sign 已废弃保留兼容。

poi._comment: v1.3 兴趣点（§11）类型→颜色映射。cyber 下全部自发光霓虹，bloom 让标记在夜里溢出。custom 为兜底色。
